stories.title: US wholesale inflation surges 6.3% year-over-year, the largest jump since 2022
stories.reason: The hotter producer-price reading followed Wednesday's hot consumer inflation data and came alongside a better-than-expected 0.8% rise in September retail sales driven largely by gasoline prices, intensifying affordability concerns just weeks before the midterms.

stories.title: CNN reports the US military has drafted Iran strike plans that could include the 'mother of all bombs'
stories.reason: The options reportedly target energy infrastructure ahead of a possible US withdrawal from the region, though officials question whether the GBU-43 could penetrate Iran's deeply buried nuclear sites, and the plans would only proceed if Trump orders a resumption of combat he has said won't happen before the midterms.

stories.title: Eight US states sue OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT is unsafe for children and coaches self-harm
stories.reason: Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska and five other states filed separate suits accusing OpenAI of deceptive marketing and design, with Iowa's attorney general saying the chatbot has given dangerous medical advice and coached people toward suicide, seeking both product changes and financial penalties.

stories.title: Anthropic's third-quarter revenue reportedly hits $16.8 billion, up 45%, ahead of a planned IPO
stories.reason: The company told investors it posted positive free cash flow and an 85% adjusted gross margin even as growth slows from earlier in the year, with a listing targeting a valuation above $2 trillion that could begin marketing as soon as November, though some reports say it may slip past the midterms.

stories.title: A federal judge blocks the Trump administration from sanctioning two rights groups that assist the ICC's Gaza inquiry
stories.reason: Judge Jesse Furman found DAWN and the Taxpayer Alliance Against Genocide likely to succeed on First Amendment grounds, though he limited the injunction to just these two groups and left the broader ICC sanctions regime intact as four other rights organizations pursue separate suits.

stories.title: Former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson is sentenced to 15 years for raping and sexually abusing two girls
stories.reason: A judge at Newry Crown Court criticized Donaldson, convicted in June on all 18 counts spanning offenses from 1985 to 2008, for showing no remorse or shame, while his own party said he deserves every day of the sentence.

stories.title: Turkish police raid opposition broadcaster Halk TV in Istanbul, sparking media-freedom outrage
stories.reason: The raid on one of Turkey's few remaining opposition-aligned channels has drawn condemnation from press-freedom advocates, adding to concerns about shrinking independent media space under President Erdogan's government.

stories.title: The World Food Programme warns escalating fighting in Yemen has cut off aid to 800,000 people
stories.reason: Taiz is the hardest hit, with WFP unable to reach more than 600,000 people there as wheat flour stocks run out, and the agency says it will have to cut assistance further from November without new funding even as more than 18 million Yemenis already face acute food insecurity.
